story: Discover the stunning White Collared Blackbird (*Pellorneum rostratum*), a member of the diverse Pellorneidae family. Native to Lowland evergreen forest; secondary growth; mangroves; peatswamp forest; and wet areas, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Near Threatened (NT) on the IUCN Red List, the White Collared Blackbird represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
